sql: SELECT var99_1j_eur FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_risque_book) LIMIT 1000
SELECT STRFTIME(date, '%Y-%m') AS mois, SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE desk = 'TAUX' AND date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000
SELECT trader, SUM(ABS(dv01_eur)) AS total_dv01 FROM v_positions WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) GROUP BY trader ORDER BY total_dv01 DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS jours_depassement_80 FROM v_limites WHERE book = 'FX_SPOT' AND utilisation_pct > 80 LIMIT 1000
SELECT book, COUNT(*) AS depassements FROM v_risque_book WHERE depassement_var = TRUE GROUP BY book LIMIT 1000
SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_10Y' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_marche) LIMIT 1000
SELECT book, SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl_total FROM v_pnl GROUP BY book ORDER BY pnl_total DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT MIN(pnl_eur) AS pire_pnl FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_USD' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_risque_book) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_positions FROM v_positions WHERE trader = 'Martin' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(var99_1j_eur) AS var_moyenne FROM v_risque_book LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(notionnel) AS notionnel_brut_total_usd FROM v_positions WHERE devise = 'USD' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) LIMIT 1000
SELECT date FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'FX_SPOT' ORDER BY var99_1j_eur DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT book, AVG(utilisation_pct) AS utilisation_moyenne FROM v_limites GROUP BY book ORDER BY utilisation_moyenne DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl_total FROM v_pnl WHERE trader = 'Dubois' LIMIT 1000
SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EURUSD' AND date = '2026-09-15' LIMIT 1000
SELECT DISTINCT limite_eur FROM v_limites LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(delta_fx_eur) AS delta_fx_total FROM v_positions WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) LIMIT 1000
SELECT book FROM v_risque_book WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_risque_book) GROUP BY book HAVING AVG(es975_1j_eur) > 300000 LIMIT 1000
SELECT STRFTIME(date, '%Y-%m') AS mois, SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl FROM v_pnl WHERE desk = 'Change' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000
SELECT date, var99_1j_eur FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR' AND date > CAST('2026-10-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY ORDER BY date LIMIT 1000
SELECT desk, COUNT(DISTINCT trader) AS nb_traders FROM v_positions GROUP BY desk ORDER BY nb_traders DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT r.var99_1j_eur FROM v_risque_book AS r JOIN v_pnl AS p ON r.book = p.book AND r.date = p.date WHERE r.book = 'TAUX_EUR' AND p.pnl_eur = (SELECT MIN(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR') LIMIT 1000
SELECT position_id, instrument, devise, ABS(notionnel) AS notional_abs FROM v_positions WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) ORDER BY notional_abs DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM v_positions LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(valeur) AS taux_moyen FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_2Y' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT DISTINCT book FROM v_positions WHERE desk = 'Taux' LIMIT 1000
SELECT book, utilisation_pct FROM v_limites WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_limites) ORDER BY utilisation_pct DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE trader = 'Robert') - (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE trader = 'Petit') AS ecart_pnl LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl_taux FROM v_pnl WHERE desk = 'TAUX' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_pnl) LIMIT 1000
SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_10Y' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_marche) LIMIT 1000
